text.p: Shares were steady on heavily reduced turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
Solidere A and B shares were unchanged at $10.25 and $10.75. Turnover fell to 105,993 from Monday's 231,246.
Banque Audi was steady at $19.125 on turnover of 14,460 shares against Monday's 21,020 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce was unchanged at $13.5 with turnover falling to 3,300 from 5,686.
The LIBX bank index held steady at 117.94.
Total BSE turnover was 123,693 shares for a value of $1,419,511 against 258,452 shares for a value of $2,877,701.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais shares, Eternit shares and Uniceramic.
The BLOM stock index held steady at 901.88 and the LISPI was unchanged at 83.61.
